text:
emma: Heads up — we're updating RBAC for on-prem control plane this week. Need checklist for KMS key policies, audit log retention, and netpol changes. Any blockers?

raj: do we need new KMS grants for the deployer role? current plan uses cross-account key alias.

morgan: Yes. Suggest least-privilege: Encrypt/Decrypt to runtime role, GenerateDataKey for rollout jobs. Also add key policy statement for admin rotate.

ollie: On-prem: hardware HSM isn't available in staging. For private customers we require HSM; for boxed installs we need documented KMS shim. Can someone draft shim template?

ana: vuln triage: last week's scanner flagged grpc-health probe exposed on 0.0.0.0 in our airgapped build. We should mitigate via netpol + service account RBAC.

emma: :thumbsup: Good catch. Proposed mitigations: 1) tighten netpol to clusterIP-only 2) add PSP/psa equivalent to restrict health endpoint 3) flow logs to syslog via audit-forwarder

raj: Also add immutable audit logs — write-once S3 + KMS enveloping. Retention 1y default for private, configurable.

morgan: For incident response playbook, if KMS key rotated accidentally, fallback: deploy emergency key alias, revoke old grants, and snapshot encrypted KV cache. Need runbook steps.

ollie: I can draft runbook. Quick Q: what about KV cache eviction policy? If we rotate key we must keep cache decryptable. Maybe a grace period where both keys valid.

ana: Agree. Add steps: 1) enable dual-key decrypt 2) snapshot cache + notify customers 3) rotate after validation

emma: Can someone post minimal netpol snippet for health svc? use allow from kube-system and liveness probes only.

morgan: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: restrict-health
  namespace: inference
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: health
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8080
```

raj: I'll schedule a short tabletop for Thursday 10am PT. Invite: sec-oncall, eng-oncall, onprem-eng, infra. Agenda: RBAC changes, KMS grants, audit pipeline, vuln triage steps.

audit-bot: New runbook created: RBAC-KMS-Onprem-2026 v1. Link: https://docs.internal/runbooks/rbac-kms-onprem-v1

emma: thanks — assign owners: Raj (KMS grants), Ollie (runbook + netpol), Morgan (incident play), Ana (vuln triage). I'll follow up with PR template.
